import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Resultant.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Mul
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Prod
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.FiniteDimension

/-! Actual bounded polynomials, endowed with their coefficient norm.
No polynomial, derivative or determinant identity is assumed. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev Coeff (n : ℕ) := Polynomial.degreeLT ℝ n

instance coeffNormedAddCommGroup (n : ℕ) : NormedAddCommGroup (Coeff n) :=
  NormedAddCommGroup.induced _ (Fin n → ℝ) (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n)
    (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective

instance coeffNormedSpace (n : ℕ) : NormedSpace ℝ (Coeff n) :=
  NormedSpace.induced ℝ _ (Fin n → ℝ) (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n)

/-- Retain exactly the coefficients of orders less than `n`. -/
def cut (n : ℕ) : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff n :=
  (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    (LinearMap.pi fun i : Fin n => Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ i)

@[simp] theorem degreeLTEquiv_coeff {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) (i : Fin n) :
    degreeLTEquiv ℝ n p i = (p : ℝ[X]).coeff i := rfl

@[simp] theorem cut_coeff (n : ℕ) (p : ℝ[X]) (i : Fin n) :
    ((cut n p : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i = p.coeff i := by
  exact congrFun ((degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).apply_symm_apply (fun j : Fin n => p.coeff j)) i

@[simp] theorem cut_coe {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : cut n (p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective
  funext i
  simp

/-- Coefficient truncation of the actual polynomial product, as a bilinear map. -/
def mulLM (m n r : ℕ) : Coeff m →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff r :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun p q => cut r ((p : ℝ[X]) * (q : ℝ[X])))
    (by intros; simp [add_mul])
    (by intros; simp [smul_mul_assoc])
    (by intros; simp [mul_add])
    (by intros; simp [mul_smul_comm])

def mulCLM (m n r : ℕ) : Coeff m →L[ℝ] Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff r :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
    ((LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap :
      (Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff r) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff r)).toLinearMap.comp
      (mulLM m n r))

@[simp] theorem mulCLM_apply {m n r : ℕ} (p : Coeff m) (q : Coeff n) :
    mulCLM m n r p q = cut r ((p : ℝ[X]) * (q : ℝ[X])) := rfl

/-- The linear inclusion of a polynomial of degree `< n` into degree `< n+1`. -/
def liftLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  (cut (n+1)).comp (degreeLT ℝ n).subtype

def liftCLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (liftLM n)

lemma coeff_eq_zero_of_bound {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) {k : ℕ} (hk : n ≤ k) :
    (p : ℝ[X]).coeff k = 0 := by
  exact Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
    ((Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mp p.property).trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hk))

@[simp] theorem coe_lift {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (liftCLM n p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  ext k
  by_cases hk : k < n+1
  · exact cut_coeff (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) ⟨k,hk⟩
  · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ (Nat.le_of_not_gt hk),
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)]

def topMonomial (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) :=
  ⟨X^n, Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr (by
    rw [Polynomial.degree_X_pow]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)⟩

def monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : Coeff (n+1) :=
  topMonomial n + liftCLM n p

@[simp] theorem coe_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]) = X^n + (p : ℝ[X]) := by
  simp [monicPoly, topMonomial]

lemma bounded_natDegree {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    (p : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ n := by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
  intro k hk
  exact coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)

/-- The affine monic-coordinate map has the actual Frechet derivative equal
    to its coefficient inclusion, including the degree-zero case. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    HasFDerivAt monicPoly (liftCLM n) p := by
  exact (liftCLM n).hasFDerivAt.const_add (topMonomial n)

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/BlockJacobian.lean:
import HydrologyTree.Coefficients

noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree
open Module

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

/-- The derivative block occurring in polynomial numerator/denominator gluing. -/
def repeatedBlock (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) : (E × E) →L[ℝ] (F × F) :=
  (L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E)).prod
    (C.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E) +
      L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E E))

@[simp] theorem repeatedBlock_apply (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E) :
    repeatedBlock L C x = (L x.1, C x.1 + L x.2) := rfl

lemma toMatrix_repeatedBlock {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F) (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bE) (bF.prod bF) (repeatedBlock L C).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap) 0
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF C.toLinearMap)
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, repeatedBlock]

/-- An exact determinant theorem: no nonsingularity assumptions on either block. -/
theorem det_repeatedBlock {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F) (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bE) (bF.prod bF)
      (repeatedBlock L C).toLinearMap).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap).det ^ 2 := by
  rw [toMatrix_repeatedBlock, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂, pow_two]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.BlockJacobian

/-! Actual triangular linear maps, with fully specified coefficient bases. -/
open Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

def lowerBlock (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F) (M : F →L[ℝ] F) :
    (E × F) →L[ℝ] (E × F) :=
  (L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E F)).prod
    (C.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E F) + M.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E F))

@[simp] lemma lowerBlock_apply (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (M : F →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × F) :
    lowerBlock L C M x = (L x.1, C x.1 + M x.2) := rfl

lemma toMatrix_lowerBlock {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis κ ℝ F)
    (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F) (M : F →L[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bF) (bE.prod bF) (lowerBlock L C M).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bE L.toLinearMap) 0
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF C.toLinearMap) (LinearMap.toMatrix bF bF M.toLinearMap) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, lowerBlock]

theorem det_lowerBlock {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis κ ℝ F)
    (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F) (M : F →L[ℝ] F) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bF) (bE.prod bF) (lowerBlock L C M).toLinearMap).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bE L.toLinearMap).det *
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bF bF M.toLinearMap).det := by
  rw [toMatrix_lowerBlock, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.Triangular
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.SchurComplement
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Block

/-! Actual conservative tree rate coordinates, with arbitrary finite size.
Vertices are topologically numbered from the designated leak/root 0.
The parameter at 0 is the leak; at every other vertex it is the transfer rate
toward its parent. No positivity or nonzero-rate premise is used below. -/
open Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- A finite rooted tree in a topological vertex numbering. Every nonroot
vertex i+1 has exactly one parent, with smaller vertex number. -/
structure OrderedTree (n : ℕ) where
  parent : Fin n → Fin (n+1)
  parent_le : ∀ i, (parent i).val ≤ i.val

abbrev VertexValues (n : ℕ) := Fin (n+1) → ℝ
abbrev EdgeValues (n : ℕ) := Fin n → ℝ
abbrev TreeRates (n : ℕ) := VertexValues n × EdgeValues n

lemma parent_ne_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (i : Fin n) :
    t.parent i ≠ i.succ := by
  intro h
  have hle := t.parent_le i
  have := congrArg Fin.val h
  simp only [Fin.val_succ] at this
  omega

/-- Parent-incidence matrix of the actual labelled tree. -/
def parentIncidence {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin n) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun v e => if t.parent e = v then 1 else 0

/-- Derivative of c_e=a_e f_e with respect to the inward/diagonal parameters. -/
def childWeighted {n : ℕ} (f : EdgeValues n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun e v => if e.succ = v then f e else 0

def parentCLM {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : EdgeValues n →L[ℝ] VertexValues n :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Matrix.toLin' (parentIncidence t))

@[simp] lemma parentCLM_apply {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (f : EdgeValues n)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) :
    parentCLM t f v = ∑ e, if t.parent e = v then f e else 0 := by
  simp [parentCLM, Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    parentIncidence, ite_mul]

/-- Physical rate chart: d_v is the sum of all rates leaving v, and c_e is
exactly the product of the two opposed rates on edge e. -/
def rateChart {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : TreeRates n :=
  (x.1 + parentCLM t x.2, fun e => x.1 e.succ * x.2 e)

def rateChartDerivative {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    TreeRates n →L[ℝ] TreeRates n :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n)) +
    (parentCLM t).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).prod
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun e : Fin n =>
      x.1 e.succ • ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))) +
      x.2 e • ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e.succ).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))))

/-- The rate-coordinate Jacobian is derived from the actual polynomial map. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_rateChart {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    HasFDerivAt (rateChart t) (rateChartDerivative t x) x := by
  apply HasFDerivAt.prodMk
  · exact (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n)).hasFDerivAt.add
      ((parentCLM t).hasFDerivAt.comp x
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n)).hasFDerivAt)
  · apply hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr
    intro e
    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e.succ).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).hasFDerivAt.mul
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).hasFDerivAt

lemma toMatrix_rateChartDerivative {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      (rateChartDerivative t x).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks 1 (parentIncidence t) (childWeighted x.2)
        (Matrix.diagonal fun e : Fin n => x.1 e.succ) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, rateChartDerivative, childWeighted,
      parentIncidence, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
      Pi.basisFun_apply, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]
  rename_i v j
  symm
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro e _ he
    simp [Ne.symm he]
  · simp

lemma childWeighted_mul_parent {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (f : EdgeValues n)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    (childWeighted f * parentIncidence t) i j = if t.parent j = i.succ then f i else 0 := by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, childWeighted, parentIncidence, ite_mul, eq_comm]

lemma rateSchur_upperTriangular {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (Matrix.diagonal (fun e : Fin n => x.1 e.succ) -
      childWeighted x.2 * parentIncidence t).IsUpperTriangular := by
  intro i j hij
  have hne : t.parent j ≠ i.succ := by
    intro h
    have hle := t.parent_le j
    have hh := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp only [Fin.val_succ] at hh
    have hijv : j.val < i.val := hij
    omega
  have hneq : i ≠ j := ne_of_gt (show j < i from hij)
  simp [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, childWeighted_mul_parent,
    hne, hneq]

lemma rateSchur_diagonal {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (i : Fin n) :
    (Matrix.diagonal (fun e : Fin n => x.1 e.succ) -
      childWeighted x.2 * parentIncidence t) i i = x.1 i.succ := by
  simp [childWeighted_mul_parent, parent_ne_child]

/-- The exact physical-rate Jacobian, for every tree size and all real rates.
In particular, zero edges are not excluded by an inverse-rate calculation. -/
theorem det_rateChartDerivative {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      (rateChartDerivative t x).toLinearMap).det = ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ := by
  rw [toMatrix_rateChartDerivative, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_one₁₁,
    Matrix.det_of_upperTriangular (rateSchur_upperTriangular t x)]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact rateSchur_diagonal t x i

/-- The true Frechet Jacobian, not a separately prescribed formal matrix. -/
def physicalRateJacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
    ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
    (fderiv ℝ (rateChart t) x).toLinearMap).det

theorem physicalRateJacobian_eq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    physicalRateJacobian t x = ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ := by
  rw [physicalRateJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_rateChart t x).fderiv,
    det_rateChartDerivative]

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/CompartmentMatrix.lean:
import HydrologyTree.RateChart
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Charpoly.Basic

/-! The actual conservative bidirected compartment matrix. Edge rates and
original boundary-exit diagonals are retained; no transfer-function reduction
is performed in these definitions. -/
open Matrix Module Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- The actual mass-conserving pair of directed transfers on one tree edge. -/
def edgeMatrix {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (e : Fin n) :
    Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ :=
  x.1 e.succ • (Matrix.single (t.parent e) e.succ (1 : ℝ) - Matrix.single e.succ e.succ (1 : ℝ)) +
    x.2 e • (Matrix.single e.succ (t.parent e) (1 : ℝ) - Matrix.single (t.parent e) (t.parent e) (1 : ℝ))

/-- Edgewise construction of the actual compartment generator, with sole leak at 0. -/
def compartmentMatrix {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ :=
  (∑ e : Fin n, edgeMatrix t x e) - x.1 0 • Matrix.single 0 0 (1 : ℝ)

lemma sum_single_column {n : ℕ} (i j w : Fin (n+1)) (r : ℝ) :
    (∑ v : Fin (n+1), (Matrix.single i j r) v w) = if j = w then r else 0 := by
  by_cases h : j = w
  · subst w
    simp [Matrix.single_apply]
  · simp [Matrix.single_apply, h]

lemma directed_transfer_column_sum {n : ℕ} (i j w : Fin (n+1)) (c : ℝ) :
    (∑ v : Fin (n+1),
      (c • (Matrix.single i j (1 : ℝ) - Matrix.single j j (1 : ℝ))) v w) = 0 := by
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_sub,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, sum_single_column, sub_self]

lemma edgeMatrix_column_sum {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (e : Fin n) (w : Fin (n+1)) :
    (∑ v : Fin (n+1), edgeMatrix t x e v w) = 0 := by
  simp only [edgeMatrix, Matrix.add_apply, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [directed_transfer_column_sum, directed_transfer_column_sum, add_zero]

/-- Exact columnwise water conservation, for every real rate vector. -/
theorem compartment_column_sum {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (w : Fin (n+1)) :
    (∑ v : Fin (n+1), compartmentMatrix t x v w) = if w = 0 then -x.1 0 else 0 := by
  simp only [compartmentMatrix, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [edgeMatrix_column_sum, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_sub,
    Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, sum_single_column]
  by_cases h : w = 0
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

/-- The vector field induced by the actual compartment matrix conserves total
water except for the root discharge. This is a matrix identity, not an ODE premise. -/
theorem compartment_total_flux {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (s : VertexValues n) :
    (∑ v : Fin (n+1), (compartmentMatrix t x *ᵥ s) v) = -x.1 0 * s 0 := by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul, compartment_column_sum]
  simp

lemma compartment_diagonal_edge {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (e : Fin n) (v : Fin (n+1)) :
    edgeMatrix t x e v v = -(if e.succ = v then x.1 e.succ else 0) -
      (if t.parent e = v then x.2 e else 0) := by
  have hp := parent_ne_child t e
  by_cases h1 : e.succ = v <;> by_cases h2 : t.parent e = v
  · exact False.elim (hp (h2.trans h1.symm))
  all_goals simp [edgeMatrix, Matrix.single_apply, h1, h2, eq_comm]

/-- The physical chart's d coordinate is the actual negative diagonal of A. -/
theorem compartment_diagonal {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v v = -(rateChart t x).1 v := by
  simp only [compartmentMatrix, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [compartment_diagonal_edge]
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  rw [rateChart]
  change -(∑ e : Fin n, if e.succ = v then x.1 e.succ else 0) -
      (∑ e : Fin n, if t.parent e = v then x.2 e else 0) -
      (x.1 0 • Matrix.single 0 0 (1 : ℝ)) v v = -(x.1 v + parentCLM t x.2 v)
  rw [parentCLM_apply]
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) v
  · simp [Matrix.single_apply, sub_eq_add_neg]
  · have hi : (0 : Fin (n+1)) ≠ i.succ := Ne.symm (Fin.succ_ne_zero i)
    simp [Matrix.single_apply, hi, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]

/-- Every off-diagonal rate is nonnegative whenever the physical rates are. -/
theorem compartment_offdiag_nonneg {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ v, 0 ≤ x.1 v) (hf : ∀ e, 0 ≤ x.2 e)
    (v w : Fin (n+1)) (hvw : v ≠ w) : 0 ≤ compartmentMatrix t x v w := by
  have hz : ∀ i : Fin (n+1), (Matrix.single i i (1 : ℝ)) v w = 0 := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = v
    · subst i
      simp [Matrix.single_apply, hvw, Ne.symm hvw]
    · simp [Matrix.single_apply, hi, Ne.symm hi]
  simp only [compartmentMatrix, edgeMatrix, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.sum_apply,
    Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.sub_apply,
    hz, sub_zero, mul_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro e _
  apply add_nonneg
  · apply mul_nonneg (ha _)
    simp only [Matrix.single_apply]
    split <;> norm_num
  · apply mul_nonneg (hf _)
    simp only [Matrix.single_apply]
    split <;> norm_num

/-- Unreduced characteristic polynomial of the actual physical model. -/
def physicalCharacteristic {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ[X] :=
  (compartmentMatrix t x).charpoly

/-- Actual root-principal minor, with the original diagonals retained. -/
def physicalRootCofactor {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ[X] :=
  ((compartmentMatrix t x).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).charpoly

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.CompartmentMatrix

/-! Identification of the rate-coordinate Jacobian with coordinates extracted
from the actual compartment matrix, rather than a surrogate parameter map. -/
open Matrix Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma no_reversed_tree_edges {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (i j : Fin n) :
    ¬(j.succ = t.parent i ∧ t.parent j = i.succ) := by
  rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
  have hpi := t.parent_le i
  have hpj := t.parent_le j
  have h1v := congrArg Fin.val h1
  have h2v := congrArg Fin.val h2
  simp only [Fin.val_succ] at h1v h2v
  omega

lemma single_diagonal_offdiag {n : ℕ} (v w i : Fin (n+1)) (hvw : v ≠ w) :
    (Matrix.single i i (1 : ℝ)) v w = 0 := by
  apply Matrix.single_apply_of_ne
  rintro ⟨hi,hj⟩
  exact hvw (hi.symm.trans hj)

lemma compartment_offdiag_formula {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v w : Fin (n+1)) (hvw : v ≠ w) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v w =
      ∑ e : Fin n, (x.1 e.succ * (if t.parent e = v ∧ e.succ = w then 1 else 0) +
        x.2 e * (if e.succ = v ∧ t.parent e = w then 1 else 0)) := by
  simp only [compartmentMatrix, edgeMatrix, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.add_apply,
    Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, single_diagonal_offdiag v w _ hvw,
    mul_zero, sub_zero, Matrix.single_apply]

/-- The entry toward the parent is exactly its physical inward rate. -/
theorem compartment_inward_entry {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (i : Fin n) :
    compartmentMatrix t x (t.parent i) i.succ = x.1 i.succ := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x _ _ (parent_ne_child t i), Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp [parent_ne_child t i, Ne.symm (parent_ne_child t i)]
  · intro j _ hji
    have hs : j.succ ≠ i.succ := fun h => hji (Fin.succ_injective _ h)
    simp [hs, no_reversed_tree_edges t i j]
  · simp

/-- The entry away from the parent is exactly its physical outward rate. -/
theorem compartment_outward_entry {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (i : Fin n) :
    compartmentMatrix t x i.succ (t.parent i) = x.2 i := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x _ _ (Ne.symm (parent_ne_child t i)),
    Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp [parent_ne_child t i, Ne.symm (parent_ne_child t i)]
  · intro j _ hji
    have hs : j.succ ≠ i.succ := fun h => hji (Fin.succ_injective _ h)
    have hr : ¬(t.parent j = i.succ ∧ j.succ = t.parent i) := by
      rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
      exact no_reversed_tree_edges t i j ⟨h2,h1⟩
    simp [hs,hr]
  · simp

/-- Diagonal and edge-product coordinates read from the actual matrix. -/
def matrixRateCoordinates {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : TreeRates n :=
  (fun v => -compartmentMatrix t x v v,
    fun i => compartmentMatrix t x (t.parent i) i.succ *
      compartmentMatrix t x i.succ (t.parent i))

/-- No physical-coordinate identification is left as an assumption. -/
theorem matrixRateCoordinates_eq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    matrixRateCoordinates t = rateChart t := by
  funext x
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext v
    simp [matrixRateCoordinates, compartment_diagonal]
  · funext i
    simp [matrixRateCoordinates, compartment_inward_entry, compartment_outward_entry, rateChart]

theorem hasFDerivAt_matrixRateCoordinates {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    HasFDerivAt (matrixRateCoordinates t) (rateChartDerivative t x) x := by
  rw [matrixRateCoordinates_eq]
  exact hasFDerivAt_rateChart t x

def matrixCoordinateJacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
    ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
    (fderiv ℝ (matrixRateCoordinates t) x).toLinearMap).det

/-- Actual matrix-coordinate Jacobian, all finite topologically numbered trees,
all real rates, including zero-rate degenerations and the one-vertex case. -/
theorem matrixCoordinateJacobian_eq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    matrixCoordinateJacobian t x = ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ := by
  rw [matrixCoordinateJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_matrixRateCoordinates t x).fderiv,
    det_rateChartDerivative]

/-- The parent function fixes the root and follows the unique inward edge elsewhere. -/
def parentVertex {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : Fin (n+1) → Fin (n+1) :=
  Fin.cases 0 t.parent

lemma parentVertex_lt {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    (parentVertex t v).val < v.val := by
  revert hv
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i _ => ?_) v
  · intro h
    exact False.elim (h rfl)
  · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (t.parent_le i)

/-- The parent encoding really is connected to the root: no disconnected
component or directed cycle can enter the theorem through its hypotheses. -/
theorem parent_reaches_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, (parentVertex t)^[k] v = 0 := by
  induction v using (measure Fin.val).wf.induction with
  | h v ih =>
    by_cases hv : v = 0
    · exact ⟨0, by simpa using hv⟩
    · obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := ih (parentVertex t v) (parentVertex_lt t v hv)
      refine ⟨k+1, ?_⟩
      simpa only [Function.iterate_succ_apply] using hk

end HydrologyTree

import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.SchurComplement

/-! Exact determinant update and attachment of two matrix blocks by one
bidirected edge. The field lemma only uses invertibility of one block;
polynomial continuation removes this restriction for characteristic matrices. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

section Ring
variable {R ι : Type*} [CommRing R] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

lemma add_single_eq_updateRow (A : Matrix ι ι R) (i j : ι) (c : R) :
    A + Matrix.single i j c = A.updateRow i (A i + Pi.single j c) := by
  ext k l
  by_cases h : k = i
  · subst k
    simp [Matrix.single_apply, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]
  · simp [Matrix.single_apply, h, Ne.symm h]

/-- The cofactor determinant identity at every matrix, singular or not. -/
theorem det_add_single (A : Matrix ι ι R) (i j : ι) (c : R) :
    (A + Matrix.single i j c).det = A.det + c * A.adjugate j i := by
  rw [add_single_eq_updateRow, Matrix.det_updateRow_add]
  have hs : (Pi.single j c : ι → R) = c • Pi.single j 1 := by
    funext k
    simp [Pi.single_apply, mul_ite]
  rw [hs, Matrix.det_updateRow_smul, ← Matrix.adjugate_apply]
  simp

theorem det_sub_single (A : Matrix ι ι R) (i j : ι) (c : R) :
    (A - Matrix.single i j c).det = A.det - c * A.adjugate j i := by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Matrix.single_neg, det_add_single]
  ring

end Ring

section Field
variable {K ι κ : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
  [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]

/-- Attach arbitrary blocks through just the specified pair of directed entries.
The diagonals are NOT recomputed; existing exit rates remain in each block. -/
def edgeJoin (A : Matrix ι ι K) (B : Matrix κ κ K) (i : ι) (j : κ) (a f : K) :
    Matrix (ι ⊕ κ) (ι ⊕ κ) K :=
  Matrix.fromBlocks A (Matrix.single i j a) (Matrix.single j i f) B

/-- Exact edge-attachment determinant when one block has nonzero determinant;
no invertibility or nonsingularity of the other block is needed. -/
theorem det_edgeJoin_of_right_ne_zero
    (A : Matrix ι ι K) (B : Matrix κ κ K) (i : ι) (j : κ) (a f : K)
    (hB : B.det ≠ 0) :
    (edgeJoin A B i j a f).det = A.det * B.det - a*f*A.adjugate i i*B.adjugate j j := by
  letI : Invertible B := Matrix.invertibleOfIsUnitDet B (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hB)
  rw [edgeJoin, Matrix.det_fromBlocks₂₂, Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv,
    Matrix.single_mul_mul_single, det_sub_single]
  rw [Matrix.inv_def]
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
  field_simp
  <;> ring

end Field
end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.EdgeDeterminant
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Charpoly.Coeff
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Roots

/-! Characteristic-polynomial attachment by a bidirected edge.
No eigenvalue simplicity, positive rate, or nonzero-rate assumption is needed.
All denominators are removed by a polynomial identity argument. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]

/-- Actual diagonal cofactor of the characteristic matrix, before cancellation. -/
def diagonalCofactor (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (i : ι) : ℝ[X] :=
  (Matrix.charmatrix A).adjugate i i

lemma eval_charmatrix (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    (Polynomial.evalRingHom s).mapMatrix (Matrix.charmatrix A) =
      Matrix.scalar ι s - A := by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq]
  · simp [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.charmatrix_apply_ne, h]

lemma eval_diagonalCofactor (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (i : ι) (s : ℝ) :
    (diagonalCofactor A i).eval s = (Matrix.scalar ι s - A).adjugate i i := by
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix ι ι ℝ => M i i)
    ((Polynomial.evalRingHom s).map_adjugate (Matrix.charmatrix A))
  rw [eval_charmatrix] at h
  exact h

lemma scalar_sub_edgeJoin (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (B : Matrix κ κ ℝ)
    (i : ι) (j : κ) (a f s : ℝ) :
    Matrix.scalar (ι ⊕ κ) s - edgeJoin A B i j a f =
      edgeJoin (Matrix.scalar ι s - A) (Matrix.scalar κ s - B) i j (-a) (-f) := by
  ext u v
  cases u <;> cases v <;>
    simp [edgeJoin, Matrix.scalar_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.single_apply, neg_ite]

/-- Every nonzero real polynomial is nonzero at infinitely many points. -/
lemma infinite_nonroots (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    Set.Infinite {s : ℝ | p.eval s ≠ 0} := by
  simpa only [Set.compl_setOf, Polynomial.IsRoot] using
    (Polynomial.finite_setOfPred_isRoot hp).infinite_compl

/-- Exact characteristic recurrence for attachment by one bidirected edge.
The original block diagonals, including exit rates, are kept unchanged. -/
theorem charpoly_edgeJoin (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (B : Matrix κ κ ℝ)
    (i : ι) (j : κ) (a f : ℝ) :
    (edgeJoin A B i j a f).charpoly =
      A.charpoly * B.charpoly - C (a*f) * diagonalCofactor A i * diagonalCofactor B j := by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  apply (infinite_nonroots B.charpoly (Matrix.charpoly_monic B).ne_zero).mono
  intro s hs
  have hd : (Matrix.scalar κ s - B).det ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [← Matrix.eval_charpoly]
  have h := det_edgeJoin_of_right_ne_zero (Matrix.scalar ι s - A)
    (Matrix.scalar κ s - B) i j (-a) (-f) hd
  simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Matrix.eval_charpoly, scalar_sub_edgeJoin, Polynomial.eval_sub,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_diagonalCofactor, neg_mul_neg] using h

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.EdgeCharacteristic
import Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination

/-! Characteristic/cofactor recursion at an attachment root. These are identities
of actual matrices and their characteristic adjugates, not recursive stand-ins. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

section Ring
variable {R ι : Type*} [CommRing R] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

lemma adjugate_add_single_self (A : Matrix ι ι R) (i : ι) (c : R) :
    (A + Matrix.single i i c).adjugate i i = A.adjugate i i := by
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply]
  congr 1
  ext k l
  by_cases h : k = i
  · subst k
    simp
  · simp [Matrix.single_apply, h, Ne.symm h]

lemma adjugate_sub_single_self (A : Matrix ι ι R) (i : ι) (c : R) :
    (A - Matrix.single i i c).adjugate i i = A.adjugate i i := by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Matrix.single_neg, adjugate_add_single_self]

end Ring

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]

lemma charmatrix_add_single_self (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (i : ι) (c : ℝ) :
    Matrix.charmatrix (A + Matrix.single i i c) =
      Matrix.charmatrix A - Matrix.single i i (C c) := by
  ext k l
  by_cases h : k = l
  · subst l
    by_cases hi : i = k
    · subst i
      simp only [Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq, Matrix.add_apply,
        Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.single_apply_same, map_add]
      ring
    · simp [Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq, Matrix.single_apply, hi]
  · have hz : ¬(i = k ∧ i = l) := by
      rintro ⟨hk,hl⟩
      exact h (hk.symm.trans hl)
    simp [Matrix.charmatrix_apply_ne, h, Matrix.single_apply, hz]

lemma charpoly_add_single_self (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (i : ι) (c : ℝ) :
    (A + Matrix.single i i c).charpoly = A.charpoly - C c * diagonalCofactor A i := by
  rw [Matrix.charpoly, charmatrix_add_single_self, det_sub_single]
  rfl

lemma diagonalCofactor_add_single_self (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (i : ι) (c : ℝ) :
    diagonalCofactor (A + Matrix.single i i c) i = diagonalCofactor A i := by
  rw [diagonalCofactor, charmatrix_add_single_self, adjugate_sub_single_self]
  rfl

lemma edgeJoin_left_diagonal_add (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (B : Matrix κ κ ℝ)
    (i : ι) (j : κ) (a f c : ℝ) :
    edgeJoin (A + Matrix.single i i c) B i j a f =
      edgeJoin A B i j a f + Matrix.single (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl i) c := by
  ext k l
  cases k <;> cases l <;> simp [edgeJoin, Matrix.single_apply]

/-- The root cofactor multiplies by the characteristic polynomial of each new
branch. This holds even when branches share roots or the connecting rates vanish. -/
theorem diagonalCofactor_edgeJoin_left (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (B : Matrix κ κ ℝ)
    (i : ι) (j : κ) (a f : ℝ) :
    diagonalCofactor (edgeJoin A B i j a f) (Sum.inl i) =
      diagonalCofactor A i * B.charpoly := by
  have h := charpoly_edgeJoin (A + Matrix.single i i 1) B i j a f
  rw [edgeJoin_left_diagonal_add, charpoly_add_single_self,
    charpoly_add_single_self, diagonalCofactor_add_single_self,
    charpoly_edgeJoin] at h
  norm_num only [map_one, one_mul] at h
  linear_combination -h

/-- Both actual determinant identities required to attach a child at the root. -/
theorem root_attachment_pair (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (B : Matrix κ κ ℝ)
    (i : ι) (j : κ) (a f : ℝ) :
    (edgeJoin A B i j a f).charpoly =
      A.charpoly * B.charpoly - C (a*f) * diagonalCofactor A i * diagonalCofactor B j ∧
    diagonalCofactor (edgeJoin A B i j a f) (Sum.inl i) =
      diagonalCofactor A i * B.charpoly :=
  ⟨charpoly_edgeJoin A B i j a f, diagonalCofactor_edgeJoin_left A B i j a f⟩

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.RootAttachment

/-! Exact leaf deletion for the characteristic polynomial of a finite real
matrix. Retained principal diagonals include all original boundary-exit rates. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]

abbrev DeletedVertex (l : ι) := {v : ι // v ≠ l}

/-- Explicit reindexing into the retained vertices and the deleted leaf. -/
def deleteVertexEquiv (l : ι) : DeletedVertex l ⊕ Unit ≃ ι where
  toFun := Sum.elim Subtype.val (fun _ => l)
  invFun v := if h : v = l then Sum.inr () else Sum.inl ⟨v,h⟩
  left_inv v := by
    rcases v with v | u
    · simp [Sum.elim, v.property]
    · cases u
      simp [Sum.elim]
  right_inv v := by
    by_cases h : v = l <;> simp [Sum.elim, h]

/-- Literal principal submatrix; its diagonal is not recalculated. -/
def deletedMatrix (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (l : ι) :
    Matrix (DeletedVertex l) (DeletedVertex l) ℝ := A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val

def singletonMatrix (d : ℝ) : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ := Matrix.of fun _ _ => d

@[simp] lemma singletonMatrix_charpoly (d : ℝ) :
    (singletonMatrix d).charpoly = X-C d := by
  rw [Matrix.charpoly, Matrix.det_unique]
  simp [singletonMatrix, Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq]

@[simp] lemma singletonMatrix_cofactor (d : ℝ) :
    diagonalCofactor (singletonMatrix d) () = 1 := by
  rw [diagonalCofactor, Matrix.adjugate_subsingleton]
  rfl

lemma charpoly_submatrix_equiv (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (e : κ ≃ ι) :
    (A.submatrix e e).charpoly = A.charpoly := by
  exact Matrix.charpoly_reindex e.symm A

/-- A structurally isolated leaf gives the actual edge-join matrix after
reindexing. The premises describe zero entries only, not any determinant formula. -/
theorem leaf_matrix_decomposition (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (l p : ι) (hp : p ≠ l)
    (hrow : ∀ v, v ≠ l → A l v = if v = p then A l p else 0)
    (hcol : ∀ v, v ≠ l → A v l = if v = p then A p l else 0) :
    A.submatrix (deleteVertexEquiv l) (deleteVertexEquiv l) =
      edgeJoin (deletedMatrix A l) (singletonMatrix (A l l)) ⟨p,hp⟩ () (A p l) (A l p) := by
  ext u v
  rcases u with u | u <;> rcases v with v | v
  · rfl
  · cases v
    simpa [edgeJoin, deleteVertexEquiv, Sum.elim, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.single_apply,
      Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm] using hcol u.val u.property
  · cases u
    simpa [edgeJoin, deleteVertexEquiv, Sum.elim, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.single_apply,
      Subtype.ext_iff, eq_comm] using hrow v.val v.property
  · cases u
    cases v
    rfl

/-- The exact finite-matrix leaf recurrence, valid at all rates and eigenvalues. -/
theorem charpoly_delete_leaf (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (l p : ι) (hp : p ≠ l)
    (hrow : ∀ v, v ≠ l → A l v = if v = p then A l p else 0)
    (hcol : ∀ v, v ≠ l → A v l = if v = p then A p l else 0) :
    A.charpoly = (X-C (A l l)) * (deletedMatrix A l).charpoly -
      C (A p l * A l p) * diagonalCofactor (deletedMatrix A l) ⟨p,hp⟩ := by
  rw [← charpoly_submatrix_equiv A (deleteVertexEquiv l),
    leaf_matrix_decomposition A l p hp hrow hcol, charpoly_edgeJoin,
    singletonMatrix_charpoly, singletonMatrix_cofactor]
  ring

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PhysicalBridge
import HydrologyTree.LeafRecursion
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Basic

/-! Actual simple graph and exact last-leaf attachment of a parent tree. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def orderedTreeGraph {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : SimpleGraph (Fin (n+1)) where
  Adj u v := ∃ e : Fin n,
    (u=t.parent e ∧ v=e.succ) ∨ (v=t.parent e ∧ u=e.succ)
  symm := by
    constructor
    rintro u v ⟨e,h⟩
    exact ⟨e,h.symm⟩
  loopless := by
    constructor
    rintro u ⟨e,h⟩
    rcases h with ⟨h1,h2⟩ | ⟨h1,h2⟩ <;>
      exact parent_ne_child t e (h1.symm.trans h2)

def appendLeafTree {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (p : Fin (n+1)) : OrderedTree (n+1) where
  parent := Fin.lastCases p.castSucc (fun e : Fin n => (t.parent e).castSucc)
  parent_le := by
    intro e
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) e
    · simpa using Nat.le_of_lt_succ p.isLt
    · simpa using t.parent_le j

@[simp] lemma appendLeaf_parent_old {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (p : Fin (n+1)) (e : Fin n) :
    (appendLeafTree t p).parent e.castSucc=(t.parent e).castSucc := by simp [appendLeafTree]

@[simp] lemma appendLeaf_parent_last {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (p : Fin (n+1)) :
    (appendLeafTree t p).parent (Fin.last n)=p.castSucc := by simp [appendLeafTree]

lemma graph_edge_child_castSucc {n : ℕ} (e : Fin n) : e.castSucc.succ=e.succ.castSucc := rfl
lemma graph_edge_child_last (n : ℕ) : (Fin.last n).succ=Fin.last (n+1) := rfl

theorem orderedTreeGraph_append_old {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (p u v : Fin (n+1)) :
    (orderedTreeGraph (appendLeafTree t p)).Adj u.castSucc v.castSucc ↔
      (orderedTreeGraph t).Adj u v := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e,he⟩
    revert he
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) e
    · intro he
      simp only [appendLeaf_parent_last,graph_edge_child_last] at he
      rcases he with ⟨_,h⟩ | ⟨_,h⟩
      · exact False.elim (Fin.castSucc_ne_last v h)
      · exact False.elim (Fin.castSucc_ne_last u h)
    · intro he
      refine ⟨j,?_⟩
      simpa only [appendLeaf_parent_old,graph_edge_child_castSucc,Fin.castSucc_inj] using he
  · rintro ⟨e,he⟩
    refine ⟨e.castSucc,?_⟩
    simpa only [appendLeaf_parent_old,graph_edge_child_castSucc,Fin.castSucc_inj] using he

theorem orderedTreeGraph_append_last {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (p u : Fin (n+1)) :
    (orderedTreeGraph (appendLeafTree t p)).Adj u.castSucc (Fin.last (n+1)) ↔ u=p := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e,he⟩
    revert he
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) e
    · intro he
      simp only [appendLeaf_parent_last,graph_edge_child_last] at he
      rcases he with ⟨h,_⟩ | ⟨h,_⟩
      · exact Fin.castSucc_injective _ h
      · exact False.elim (Fin.castSucc_ne_last p h.symm)
    · intro he
      simp only [appendLeaf_parent_old,graph_edge_child_castSucc] at he
      rcases he with ⟨_,h⟩ | ⟨h,_⟩
      · exact False.elim (Fin.castSucc_ne_last j.succ h.symm)

  toFun := Fin.lastCases l (fun i => (e i).val)

    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i

    · simp [(e j).property]

    by_cases h : v=l
    · subst v

    · simp [h]

    (l : V) (e : Fin (n+1) ≃ {v : V // v ≠ l}) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    appendLeafEnumeration l e i.castSucc=(e i).val := by simp [appendLeafEnumeration]

@[simp] lemma appendLeafEnumeration_last {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V] {n : ℕ}
    (l : V) (e : Fin (n+1) ≃ {v : V // v ≠ l}) :
    appendLeafEnumeration l e (Fin.last (n+1))=l := by simp [appendLeafEnumeration]

/-! Every independently presented finite rooted simple tree admits an exact
root-preserving parent presentation. No numbering hypothesis is assumed. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

structure RootedTreePresentation {V : Type*} (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph V) (o : V) where
  tree : OrderedTree n
  vertices : Fin (n+1) ≃ V
  root_eq : vertices 0=o
  adj_iff : ∀ i j, (orderedTreeGraph tree).Adj i j ↔ G.Adj (vertices i) (vertices j)

lemma finite_tree_nonroot_leaf {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.IsTree) (o : V) (hcard : 1 < Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ l : V, l ≠ o ∧ G.degree l=1 := by
  classical
  letI : Nontrivial V := Fintype.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp hcard
  obtain ⟨u,v,hne,hu,hv⟩ := hG.exists_ne_and_degree_eq_one
  by_cases h : u=o
  · refine ⟨v,?_,hv⟩
    intro he
    exact hne (h.trans he.symm)
  · exact ⟨u,h,hu⟩

/-- Structural existence for every size, including the singleton. -/
theorem finite_rooted_tree_presentation (n : ℕ) {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (o : V) (hG : G.IsTree) (hN : Fintype.card V=n+1) :
    Nonempty (RootedTreePresentation n G o) := by
  classical
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing V with
  | h n ih =>
    by_cases hn : n=0
    · subst n
      letI : Subsingleton V := Fintype.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton.mp (by omega)
      let e : Fin 1 ≃ V :=
        { toFun := fun _ => o
          invFun := fun _ => 0
          left_inv := fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
          right_inv := fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _ }
      let t : OrderedTree 0 := ⟨Fin.elim0,fun i => Fin.elim0 i⟩
      refine ⟨⟨t,e,rfl,?_⟩⟩
      intro i j
      have hij : i=j := by apply Fin.ext; omega
      subst j
      simp
    · obtain ⟨k,rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn
      obtain ⟨l,hlo,hldeg⟩ := finite_tree_nonroot_leaf G hG o (by omega)
      let W := {v : V // v ≠ l}
      let H : SimpleGraph W := G.induce {v | v ≠ l}
      let root : W := ⟨o,Ne.symm hlo⟩
      have hW : Fintype.card W=k+1 := by
        have hh := Fintype.card_congr (deleteVertexEquiv l)
        have hunit : Fintype.card Unit=1 := by simp
        rw [Fintype.card_sum,hunit,hN] at hh
        change Fintype.card W+1=k+1+1 at hh
        omega
      have hH : H.IsTree := by
        refine ⟨?_,hG.isAcyclic.induce _⟩
        simpa only [H,Set.compl_singleton_eq] using
          hG.connected.induce_compl_singleton_of_degree_eq_one hldeg
      obtain ⟨p0⟩ := ih k (Nat.lt_succ_self k) H root hH hW
      obtain ⟨v,hv,hvuniq⟩ := SimpleGraph.degree_eq_one_iff_existsUnique_adj.mp hldeg
      have hvl : v ≠ l := by
        intro h
        subst v
        exact G.irrefl hv
      let vp : W := ⟨v,hvl⟩
      let q : Fin (k+1) := p0.vertices.symm vp
      let t := appendLeafTree p0.tree q
      let e := appendLeafEnumeration l p0.vertices
      have hroot : e 0=o := by
        change appendLeafEnumeration l p0.vertices (0 : Fin (k+1)).castSucc=o
        rw [appendLeafEnumeration_old]
        exact congrArg Subtype.val p0.root_eq
      have hleaf (i : Fin (k+1)) : G.Adj (p0.vertices i).val l ↔ i=q := by
        constructor
        · intro hi
          apply p0.vertices.injective
          rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
          apply Subtype.ext
          exact hvuniq _ hi.symm
        · intro hi
          subst i
          change G.Adj (p0.vertices (p0.vertices.symm vp)).val l
          rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
          exact hv.symm
      refine ⟨⟨t,e,hroot,?_⟩⟩
      intro i j
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
      · refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
        · simp
        · simp only [t,e,appendLeafEnumeration_last,appendLeafEnumeration_old]
          change (orderedTreeGraph (appendLeafTree p0.tree q)).Adj (Fin.last (k+1)) j.castSucc ↔
            G.Adj l (p0.vertices j).val
          constructor
          · intro h
            exact ((hleaf j).mpr ((orderedTreeGraph_append_last p0.tree q j).mp h.symm)).symm
          · intro h
            exact ((orderedTreeGraph_append_last p0.tree q j).mpr ((hleaf j).mp h.symm)).symm
      · refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
        · simp only [t,e,appendLeafEnumeration_last,appendLeafEnumeration_old]
          change (orderedTreeGraph (appendLeafTree p0.tree q)).Adj i.castSucc (Fin.last (k+1)) ↔
            G.Adj (p0.vertices i).val l
          exact (orderedTreeGraph_append_last p0.tree q i).trans (hleaf i).symm
        · simp only [t,e,appendLeafEnumeration_last,appendLeafEnumeration_old]
          change (orderedTreeGraph (appendLeafTree p0.tree q)).Adj i.castSucc j.castSucc ↔
            G.Adj (p0.vertices i).val (p0.vertices j).val
          rw [orderedTreeGraph_append_old]
          exact p0.adj_iff i j

/-- A presentation constructed only from the original graph and designated root. -/
def finiteGraphPresentation {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : G.IsTree) (o : V) :
    RootedTreePresentation (Fintype.card V-1) G o := by
  have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card V := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨o⟩
  exact Classical.choice (finite_rooted_tree_presentation (Fintype.card V-1) G o hG (by omega))

/-! Canonical root-branch partition of the original parent-encoded finite tree.
This is combinatorial data independent of every rate parameter. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- The unique first vertex after root 0 on the parent path of v; root maps to 0. -/
def rootBranchVertex {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) : Fin (n+1) :=
  if hv : v = 0 then 0
  else if parentVertex t v = 0 then v
  else rootBranchVertex t (parentVertex t v)
termination_by v.val
decreasing_by exact parentVertex_lt t v hv

@[simp] lemma rootBranchVertex_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    rootBranchVertex t 0 = 0 := by rw [rootBranchVertex]; simp

lemma rootBranchVertex_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1))
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : parentVertex t v = 0) : rootBranchVertex t v = v := by
  rw [rootBranchVertex]
  simp [hv,hp]

lemma rootBranchVertex_step {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1))
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : parentVertex t v ≠ 0) :
    rootBranchVertex t v = rootBranchVertex t (parentVertex t v) := by
  rw [rootBranchVertex]
  simp [hv,hp]

/-- A nonroot vertex belongs to a nonroot branch. -/
theorem rootBranchVertex_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    rootBranchVertex t v ≠ 0 := by
  induction v using (measure Fin.val).wf.induction with
  | h v ih =>
    by_cases hp : parentVertex t v = 0
    · rwa [rootBranchVertex_child t v hv hp]
    · rw [rootBranchVertex_step t v hv hp]
      exact ih (parentVertex t v) (parentVertex_lt t v hv) hp

/-- The branch representative is always a direct child of the root. -/
theorem rootBranchVertex_parent_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    parentVertex t (rootBranchVertex t v) = 0 := by
  induction v using (measure Fin.val).wf.induction with
  | h v ih =>
    by_cases hp : parentVertex t v = 0
    · rwa [rootBranchVertex_child t v hv hp]
    · rw [rootBranchVertex_step t v hv hp]
      exact ih (parentVertex t v) (parentVertex_lt t v hv) hp

abbrev RootChild {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :=
  {v : Fin (n+1) // v ≠ 0 ∧ parentVertex t v = 0}

abbrev BranchVertex {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) :=
  {v : Fin (n+1) // rootBranchVertex t v = c.val}

lemma branchVertex_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (v : BranchVertex t c) :
    v.val ≠ 0 := by
  intro hv
  have hh := v.property
  rw [hv, rootBranchVertex_zero] at hh
  exact c.property.1 hh.symm

def branchRootVertex {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) : BranchVertex t c :=
  ⟨c.val, rootBranchVertex_child t c.val c.property.1 c.property.2⟩

def rootPartitionMap {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Unit ⊕ (Σ c : RootChild t, BranchVertex t c) → Fin (n+1)
  | .inl _ => 0
  | .inr v => v.2.val

lemma rootPartitionMap_injective {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Function.Injective (rootPartitionMap t) := by
  intro u v h
  rcases u with u | ⟨c,u⟩ <;> rcases v with v | ⟨d,v⟩
  · cases u; cases v; rfl
  · exact False.elim (branchVertex_ne_zero t d v h.symm)
  · exact False.elim (branchVertex_ne_zero t c u h)
  · have hc : c = d := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact u.property.symm.trans ((congrArg (rootBranchVertex t) h).trans v.property)
    subst d
    have huv : u = v := Subtype.ext h
    subst v
    rfl

lemma rootPartitionMap_surjective {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Function.Surjective (rootPartitionMap t) := by
  intro v
  by_cases hv : v = 0
  · exact ⟨.inl (), hv.symm⟩
  · let c : RootChild t := ⟨rootBranchVertex t v,
      rootBranchVertex_ne_zero t v hv, rootBranchVertex_parent_zero t v hv⟩
    exact ⟨.inr ⟨c,⟨v,rfl⟩⟩,rfl⟩

/-- Exact rate-independent reindexing of all vertices into root and child branches. -/
def rootPartitionEquiv {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Unit ⊕ (Σ c : RootChild t, BranchVertex t c) ≃ Fin (n+1) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (rootPartitionMap t) ⟨rootPartitionMap_injective t,rootPartitionMap_surjective t⟩

@[simp] lemma rootPartitionEquiv_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    rootPartitionEquiv t (.inl ()) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma rootPartitionEquiv_branch {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (c : RootChild t) (v : BranchVertex t c) :
    rootPartitionEquiv t (.inr ⟨c,v⟩) = v.val := rfl

end HydrologyTree

/-! Exact sparsity of the physical tree matrix under its proved root-branch
partition. No partition of the matrix is assumed as a proof input. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma rootBranch_edge_step {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (e : Fin n)
    (hp : t.parent e ≠ 0) :
    rootBranchVertex t e.succ = rootBranchVertex t (t.parent e) := by
  exact rootBranchVertex_step t e.succ (Fin.succ_ne_zero e) hp

/-- Distinct nonroot branches have no direct physical transfer in either direction. -/
theorem compartment_cross_branch_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v w : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0)
    (hb : rootBranchVertex t v ≠ rootBranchVertex t w) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v w = 0 := by
  have hvw : v ≠ w := fun h => hb (congrArg (rootBranchVertex t) h)
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x v w hvw]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro e _
  have h1 : ¬(t.parent e = v ∧ e.succ = w) := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    have hp : t.parent e ≠ 0 := by rwa [h1]
    have hh := rootBranch_edge_step t e hp
    rw [h1,h2] at hh
    exact hb hh.symm
  have h2 : ¬(e.succ = v ∧ t.parent e = w) := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    have hp : t.parent e ≠ 0 := by rwa [h2]
    have hh := rootBranch_edge_step t e hp
    rw [h1,h2] at hh
    exact hb hh
  simp [h1,h2]

/-- Actual principal branch block, retaining the outgoing-to-root diagonal. -/
def physicalBranchMatrix {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t) :
    Matrix (BranchVertex t c) (BranchVertex t c) ℝ :=
  (compartmentMatrix t x).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val

/-- The reindexed physical matrix has the exact actual branch on each diagonal block. -/
theorem rootPartition_same_block {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (c : RootChild t) (v w : BranchVertex t c) :
    ((compartmentMatrix t x).submatrix (rootPartitionEquiv t) (rootPartitionEquiv t))
      (.inr ⟨c,v⟩) (.inr ⟨c,w⟩) = physicalBranchMatrix t x c v w := rfl

/-- Every cross-block entry of the actual reindexed matrix vanishes. -/
theorem rootPartition_different_blocks {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (c d : RootChild t) (hcd : c ≠ d) (v : BranchVertex t c) (w : BranchVertex t d) :
    ((compartmentMatrix t x).submatrix (rootPartitionEquiv t) (rootPartitionEquiv t))
      (.inr ⟨c,v⟩) (.inr ⟨d,w⟩) = 0 := by
  apply compartment_cross_branch_zero t x v.val w.val
    (branchVertex_ne_zero t c v) (branchVertex_ne_zero t d w)
  intro h
  apply hcd
  exact Subtype.ext (v.property.symm.trans (h.trans w.property))

lemma parentVertex_succ {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (e : Fin n) :
    parentVertex t e.succ = t.parent e := rfl

/-- A nondirect descendant has no inward transfer to the root. -/
theorem compartment_root_column_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : parentVertex t v ≠ 0) :
    compartmentMatrix t x 0 v = 0 := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x 0 v (Ne.symm hv)]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro e _
  have h1 : ¬(t.parent e = 0 ∧ e.succ = v) := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    apply hp
    rw [← h2, parentVertex_succ, h1]
  simp [h1, Fin.succ_ne_zero]

/-- A nondirect descendant receives no outward transfer directly from the root. -/
theorem compartment_root_row_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : parentVertex t v ≠ 0) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v 0 = 0 := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x v 0 hv]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro e _
  have h2 : ¬(e.succ = v ∧ t.parent e = 0) := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    apply hp
    rw [← h1, parentVertex_succ, h2]
  simp [h2, Fin.succ_ne_zero]

lemma branch_nonroot_parent_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t)
    (v : BranchVertex t c) (hvc : v.val ≠ c.val) : parentVertex t v.val ≠ 0 := by
  intro hp
  have h := rootBranchVertex_child t v.val (branchVertex_ne_zero t c v) hp
  rw [v.property] at h
  exact hvc h.symm

/-- The root row meets a branch only at that branch's actual root vertex. -/
theorem rootPartition_root_to_branch {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (c : RootChild t) (v : BranchVertex t c) :
    compartmentMatrix t x 0 v.val =
      if v.val = c.val then compartmentMatrix t x 0 c.val else 0 := by
  by_cases h : v.val = c.val
  · simp [h]
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact compartment_root_column_zero t x v.val (branchVertex_ne_zero t c v)
      (branch_nonroot_parent_ne_zero t c v h)

/-- The root column meets a branch only at that branch's actual root vertex. -/
theorem rootPartition_branch_to_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (c : RootChild t) (v : BranchVertex t c) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v.val 0 =
      if v.val = c.val then compartmentMatrix t x c.val 0 else 0 := by
  by_cases h : v.val = c.val
  · simp [h]
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact compartment_root_row_zero t x v.val (branchVertex_ne_zero t c v)
      (branch_nonroot_parent_ne_zero t c v h)

lemma rootBranchVertex_le {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) :

    by_cases hv : v = 0
    · subst v; simp

lemma branchRoot_min {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (v : BranchVertex t c) :
    branchRootVertex t c ≤ v := by

  exact v.property.symm.le.trans (rootBranchVertex_le t v.val)

lemma branch_card_pos {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) :
    0 < Fintype.card (BranchVertex t c) := by

  Fintype.card (BranchVertex t c) - 1

lemma child_card {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) :
    Fintype.card (BranchVertex t c) = childEdgeCount t c + 1 := by
  unfold childEdgeCount
  have := branch_card_pos t c
  omega

/-- Original vertex order induces a canonical increasing enumeration of a child. -/
def childEnumeration {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) :
    Fin (childEdgeCount t c + 1) ≃o BranchVertex t c :=
  Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq _ (child_card t c)

@[simp] theorem childEnumeration_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) :
    childEnumeration t c 0 = branchRootVertex t c := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := (childEnumeration t c).surjective (branchRootVertex t c)
    rw [← hj]

  intro h
  have he : childEnumeration t c i.succ = childEnumeration t c 0 := by
    rw [childEnumeration_zero]

  ⟨parentVertex t (childEnumeration t c i.succ).val, by
    have hv := branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c i.succ)
    have hp := branch_nonroot_parent_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c i.succ)
      (childEnumeration_ne_root t c i)
    exact (rootBranchVertex_step t _ hv hp).symm.trans (childEnumeration t c i.succ).property⟩

/-- The actual parent map in the child's own topological numbering. -/
def childTree {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) : OrderedTree (childEdgeCount t c) where
  parent i := (childEnumeration t c).symm (childParentVertex t c i)
  parent_le i := by
    have h : (childEnumeration t c).symm (childParentVertex t c i) < i.succ := by
      apply (childEnumeration t c).lt_iff_lt.mp
      rw [OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]
      exact parentVertex_lt t _ (branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c i.succ))
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ h

    (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c)) :
    (childEnumeration t c ((childTree t c).parent i)).val =
      parentVertex t (childEnumeration t c i.succ).val := by
  exact congrArg Subtype.val ((childEnumeration t c).apply_symm_apply (childParentVertex t c i))

/-- Each child has strictly fewer edges than its original tree. -/
theorem childEdgeCount_lt {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) :
    childEdgeCount t c < n := by

      (⟨v.val, branchVertex_ne_zero t c v⟩ : {v : Fin (n+1) // v ≠ 0})) := by

  have hnon : Fintype.card {v : Fin (n+1) // v ≠ 0} = n := by

/-! Pointwise formulas for actual physical transfer entries, including the root.
No invertibility, positivity or nonzero transfer rate is assumed. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Extend edge data to vertices by assigning zero to the original root. -/
def outwardByVertex {n : ℕ} (f : EdgeValues n) : VertexValues n := Fin.cases 0 f

@[simp] lemma outwardByVertex_zero {n : ℕ} (f : EdgeValues n) : outwardByVertex f 0 = 0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma outwardByVertex_succ {n : ℕ} (f : EdgeValues n) (i : Fin n) :
    outwardByVertex f i.succ = f i := rfl

lemma sum_inward_transfer {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (a : VertexValues n)
    (v w : Fin (n+1)) :
    (∑ e : Fin n, a e.succ * (if t.parent e = v ∧ e.succ = w then 1 else 0)) =
      if w = 0 then 0 else if parentVertex t w = v then a w else 0 := by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) w
  · simp [Fin.succ_ne_zero]
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp [parentVertex, mul_ite] <;> rfl
    · intro j _ hji
      have hs : j.succ ≠ i.succ := fun h => hji (Fin.succ_injective _ h)
      simp [hs]
    · simp

lemma sum_outward_transfer {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (f : EdgeValues n)
    (v w : Fin (n+1)) :
    (∑ e : Fin n, f e * (if e.succ = v ∧ t.parent e = w then 1 else 0)) =
      if v = 0 then 0 else if parentVertex t v = w then outwardByVertex f v else 0 := by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) v
  · simp [Fin.succ_ne_zero]
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp [parentVertex, mul_ite] <;> rfl
    · intro j _ hji
      have hs : j.succ ≠ i.succ := fun h => hji (Fin.succ_injective _ h)
      simp [hs]
    · simp

/-- Only the two directed edges relating a vertex and its parent contribute. -/
theorem compartment_offdiag_parent_formula {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v w : Fin (n+1)) (hvw : v ≠ w) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v w =
      (if w = 0 then 0 else if parentVertex t w = v then x.1 w else 0) +
      (if v = 0 then 0 else if parentVertex t v = w then outwardByVertex x.2 v else 0) := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x v w hvw, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    sum_inward_transfer, sum_outward_transfer]

end HydrologyTree

/-! Rate extraction preserves the actual exit-to-parent rate as the child's
single leak. All constructions are defined for every real rate vector. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Pull back inward rates (including the new root leak) and internal outward rates. -/
def childRates {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n) :
    TreeRates (childEdgeCount t c) :=
  (fun i => x.1 (childEnumeration t c i).val,
    fun i => outwardByVertex x.2 (childEnumeration t c i.succ).val)

    (childRates t c x).1 0 = x.1 c.val := by
  simp [childRates, branchRootVertex]

lemma childEnumeration_injective {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) :
    Function.Injective (fun i => (childEnumeration t c i).val) := by
  intro i j h
  exact (childEnumeration t c).injective (Subtype.ext h)

lemma childParent_eq_iff {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t)
    (i j : Fin (childEdgeCount t c + 1)) :
    parentVertex t (childEnumeration t c j).val = (childEnumeration t c i).val ↔
      j ≠ 0 ∧ parentVertex (childTree t c) j = i := by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun e => ?_) j
  · rw [childEnumeration_zero]
    have h : parentVertex t (branchRootVertex t c).val = 0 := c.property.2
    rw [h]
    simp only [ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, false_and, iff_false]
    exact Ne.symm (branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c i))
  · rw [← childTree_parent_transport t c e]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨Fin.succ_ne_zero e, childEnumeration_injective t c h⟩
    · intro h
      exact congrArg (fun k => (childEnumeration t c k).val) h.2

lemma childRates_outward {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n)
    (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c + 1)) (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    outwardByVertex (childRates t c x).2 i = outwardByVertex x.2 (childEnumeration t c i).val := by
  revert hi
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun e _ => ?_) i
  · intro h; exact False.elim (h rfl)
  · rfl

/-- Every off-diagonal entry of a child generator equals its original principal-block entry. -/
theorem childMatrix_offdiag {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n)
    (i j : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    compartmentMatrix (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) i j =
      compartmentMatrix t x (childEnumeration t c i).val (childEnumeration t c j).val := by
  have hne : (childEnumeration t c i).val ≠ (childEnumeration t c j).val :=
    fun h => hij (childEnumeration_injective t c h)
  rw [compartment_offdiag_parent_formula _ _ _ _ hij,
    compartment_offdiag_parent_formula _ _ _ _ hne]
  have hi := branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c i)
  have hj := branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c j)
  simp only [ite_eq_right hi, ite_eq_right hj, childParent_eq_iff]
  by_cases h0 : i = 0 <;> by_cases h1 : j = 0
  all_goals simp only [h0, h1, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, false_and,
    not_false_eq_true, true_and, ite_true, ite_false]
  all_goals try rfl
  all_goals rw [childRates_outward t c x _ h0]
  all_goals rfl

end HydrologyTree

noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev NumberedChildNodes {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :=
  Σ c : RootChild t, Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)

/-- Exact reindexing from the original vertices to root and numbered children. -/
def numberedRootEquiv {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : Unit ⊕ NumberedChildNodes t ≃ Fin (n+1) :=
  (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl Unit)
    (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight fun c => (childEnumeration t c).toEquiv)).trans (rootPartitionEquiv t)

@[simp] theorem numberedRootEquiv_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    numberedRootEquiv t (.inl ()) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] theorem numberedRootEquiv_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (c : RootChild t) (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) :
    numberedRootEquiv t (.inr ⟨c,i⟩) = (childEnumeration t c i).val := rfl

/-- Each nonroot vertex labels precisely one outward rate, including connector edges. -/
def numberedEdgeIndex {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (z : NumberedChildNodes t) : Fin n :=
  (childEnumeration t z.1 z.2).val.pred (branchVertex_ne_zero t z.1 _)

@[simp] lemma numberedEdgeIndex_succ {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (z : NumberedChildNodes t) :
    (numberedEdgeIndex t z).succ = (childEnumeration t z.1 z.2).val := Fin.succ_pred _ _

lemma numberedEdgeIndex_injective {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Function.Injective (numberedEdgeIndex t) := by
  intro z w h
  have hs := congrArg Fin.succ h
  rw [numberedEdgeIndex_succ, numberedEdgeIndex_succ] at hs
  have he : numberedRootEquiv t (.inr z) = numberedRootEquiv t (.inr w) := hs
  exact Sum.inr_injective ((numberedRootEquiv t).injective he)

lemma numberedEdgeIndex_surjective {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Function.Surjective (numberedEdgeIndex t) := by
  intro e
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := (numberedRootEquiv t).surjective e.succ
  rcases z with u | z
  · cases u
    exact False.elim (Fin.succ_ne_zero e hz.symm)
  · refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    apply Fin.succ_injective
    exact (numberedEdgeIndex_succ t z).trans hz

/-- This is a bijection, not an assumption that the extracted rates are independent. -/
def numberedEdgeEquiv {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : NumberedChildNodes t ≃ Fin n :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (numberedEdgeIndex t)
    ⟨numberedEdgeIndex_injective t, numberedEdgeIndex_surjective t⟩

    (c : RootChild t) (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) :
    f (numberedEdgeEquiv t ⟨c,i⟩) = outwardByVertex f (childEnumeration t c i).val := by
  rw [← numberedEdgeIndex_succ t ⟨c,i⟩]
  rfl

/-- Exact dimension count for the complete child partition. -/
theorem sum_child_vertices {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    (∑ c : RootChild t, (childEdgeCount t c+1)) = n := by
  have h := Fintype.card_congr (numberedEdgeEquiv t)
  simpa only [Fintype.card_sigma, Fintype.card_fin] using h

end HydrologyTree

def vectorReindex {ι κ : Type*} (e : ι ≃ κ) : (κ → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (ι → ℝ) where
  toFun f i := f (e i)
  invFun g j := g (e.symm j)
  left_inv f := by funext j; simp
  right_inv g := by funext i; simp
  map_add' f g := rfl
  map_smul' c f := rfl

/-- Separate the singleton root from the numbered branch-coordinate functions. -/
def splitRootFamily {C : Type*} (m : C → ℕ) :
    (Unit ⊕ (Σ c : C, Fin (m c+1)) → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ]
      ℝ × ((c : C) → VertexValues (m c)) where
  toFun f := (f (.inl ()), fun c i => f (.inr ⟨c,i⟩))
  invFun z v := match v with
    | .inl _ => z.1
    | .inr v => z.2 v.1 v.2
  left_inv f := by funext v; rcases v with u | ⟨c,i⟩; cases u <;> rfl; rfl
  right_inv z := rfl
  map_add' f g := rfl
  map_smul' c f := rfl

def curryChildValues {C : Type*} (m : C → ℕ) :
    ((Σ c : C, Fin (m c+1)) → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] ((c : C) → VertexValues (m c)) where
  toFun f c i := f ⟨c,i⟩
  invFun g v := g v.1 v.2
  left_inv f := rfl
  right_inv g := rfl
  map_add' f g := rfl
  map_smul' c f := rfl

/-- The only regrouping: the first outward coordinate is a connector rate,
while the remaining outward coordinates are internal to the child. -/
def regroupChildRates {C : Type*} (m : C → ℕ) :
    ((ℝ × ((c : C) → VertexValues (m c))) × ((c : C) → VertexValues (m c))) ≃ₗ[ℝ]
      ℝ × ((c : C) → ℝ × TreeRates (m c)) where
  toFun z := (z.1.1, fun c => (z.2 c 0, (z.1.2 c, fun i => z.2 c i.succ)))
  invFun z := ((z.1, fun c => (z.2 c).2.1), fun c => Fin.cons (z.2 c).1 (z.2 c).2.2)
  left_inv z := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · funext c i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
  right_inv z := rfl
  map_add' f g := rfl
  map_smul' c f := rfl

abbrev ChildRateData {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :=
  (c : RootChild t) → ℝ × TreeRates (childEdgeCount t c)
abbrev PartitionedRates {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) := ℝ × ChildRateData t

/-- Exact bijective linear coordinate permutation; no independence premise is used. -/
def ratePartitionEquiv {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    TreeRates n ≃ₗ[ℝ] PartitionedRates t :=
  ((vectorReindex (numberedRootEquiv t)).trans (splitRootFamily (childEdgeCount t))).prodCongr
    ((vectorReindex (numberedEdgeEquiv t)).trans (curryChildValues (childEdgeCount t))) |>.trans
      (regroupChildRates (childEdgeCount t))

@[simp] theorem ratePartition_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (ratePartitionEquiv t x).1 = x.1 0 := rfl

/-- The forward permutation agrees with the actual previously proved physical child rates. -/
theorem ratePartition_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t) :
    (ratePartitionEquiv t x).2 c = (outwardByVertex x.2 c.val, childRates t c x) := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · change x.2 (numberedEdgeEquiv t ⟨c,0⟩) = _
    rw [outward_at_numbered_child t x.2 c 0, childEnumeration_zero]
    rfl
  · apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · funext i
      exact outward_at_numbered_child t x.2 c i.succ

/-- Arbitrary connector rates and arbitrary physical child parameters occur,
uniquely, in an original rate vector. No generic-rank or positivity premise. -/
theorem ratePartition_existsUnique {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (z : PartitionedRates t) :
    ∃! x : TreeRates n, ratePartitionEquiv t x = z := by
  exact ⟨(ratePartitionEquiv t).symm z, (ratePartitionEquiv t).apply_symm_apply z,
    fun y hy => (ratePartitionEquiv t).injective (hy.trans ((ratePartitionEquiv t).apply_symm_apply z).symm)⟩

/-- The permutation is continuous and has its actual derivative equal to itself. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_ratePartition {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    HasFDerivAt (ratePartitionEquiv t)
      (ratePartitionEquiv t).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap x :=
  (ratePartitionEquiv t).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt

end HydrologyTree

noncomputable section

variable {C Y : Type*} [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C]

@[simp] lemma sumCoordinates_apply (f : C → ℝ) : sumCoordinates f = ∑ c, f c := by

connector has coefficient equal to its child leak. -/
def couplingFiber (a : C → ℝ) : (ℝ × (C → ℝ)) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × (C → ℝ)) :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (C → ℝ)) +
    sumCoordinates.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (C → ℝ))).prod
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun c => a c •
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj c).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (C → ℝ)))

    couplingFiber a z = (z.1 + ∑ c, z.2 c, fun c => a c * z.2 c) := by
  simp [couplingFiber]

    LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ C))
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ C)) (couplingFiber a).toLinearMap =
    Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ) (Matrix.of fun _ _ => 1) 0 (Matrix.diagonal a) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, couplingFiber, sumCoordinates,
      Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Pi.basisFun_apply,
      Pi.single_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

    (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ C))
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ C)) (couplingFiber a).toLinearMap).det =
      ∏ c, a c := by

  (0 : Y →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun c => f c • (ContinuousLinearMap.proj c).comp a)

  lowerBlock (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Y) (couplingCross a z.2.2) (couplingFiber (a z.1))

  let Q : (Y × (ℝ × (C → ℝ))) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × (C → ℝ)) := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ Y _

  let F := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (C → ℝ)).comp Q

  intro h
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · apply Prod.ext
    · change h.2.1 + sumCoordinates h.2.2 = 0 + (h.2.1 + sumCoordinates h.2.2)

  constructor
  · intro hp
    have h := rootBranchVertex_child t _ (branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c i)) hp
    have he := (childEnumeration t c i).property.symm.trans h
    exact (childEnumeration_root_iff t c i).mp he.symm

  · rw [ite_eq_left rfl, outward_at_numbered_child t f c 0, childEnumeration_zero]
    rfl

abbrev ChildStates {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) := (c : RootChild t) → TreeRates (childEdgeCount t c)

noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma root_inward_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n) :

  rw [compartment_offdiag_parent_formula t x 0 c.val (Ne.symm c.property.1)]
  simp only [ite_eq_right c.property.1, c.property.2, ite_true, add_zero]

    (w : BranchVertex t c) :
    (∑ v : Fin (n+1), compartmentMatrix t x v w.val) =
      compartmentMatrix t x 0 w.val +
      ∑ v : BranchVertex t c, compartmentMatrix t x v.val w.val := by
  classical
  rw [← (rootPartitionEquiv t).sum_comp (fun v => compartmentMatrix t x v w.val)]
  rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fintype.sum_sigma]
  simp only [rootPartitionEquiv_root, rootPartitionEquiv_branch, Fintype.sum_unique]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single c]
  · intro d _ hdc
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro v _
    exact rootPartition_different_blocks t x d c hdc v w
  · simp

theorem physicalBranch_column_sum {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n)
    (w : BranchVertex t c) :

      if w.val = c.val then -x.1 c.val else 0 := by
  have h := root_column_split t c x w
  rw [compartment_column_sum, ite_eq_right (branchVertex_ne_zero t c w),
    rootPartition_root_to_branch, root_inward_child] at h
  change (∑ v : BranchVertex t c, compartmentMatrix t x v.val w.val) = _
  by_cases hw : w.val = c.val
  · rw [ite_eq_left hw] at h ⊢
    linarith
  · rw [ite_eq_right hw] at h ⊢
    simpa using h.symm

/-- Column conservation after the canonical increasing child renumbering. -/
theorem childPrincipal_column_sum {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n)
    (j : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) :
    (∑ i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1),
      compartmentMatrix t x (childEnumeration t c i).val (childEnumeration t c j).val) =
      if j = 0 then -x.1 c.val else 0 := by
  have h := (childEnumeration t c).toEquiv.sum_comp
    (fun v : BranchVertex t c => compartmentMatrix t x v.val (childEnumeration t c j).val)
  apply h.trans
  change (∑ v : BranchVertex t c, physicalBranchMatrix t x c v (childEnumeration t c j)) = _

  have he : (childEnumeration t c j).val = c.val ↔ j = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      apply (childEnumeration t c).injective
      rw [childEnumeration_zero]
      exact Subtype.ext h
    · intro h
      subst j
      simp [branchRootVertex]
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left (he.mpr hj), ite_eq_left hj]
  · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h => hj (he.mp h)), ite_eq_right hj]

open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma monic_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]).Monic := by
  rw [coe_monicPoly]
  exact Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add (Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mp p.property)

@[simp] lemma monicPoly_coeff_top {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]).coeff n = 1 := by
  simp [coe_monicPoly, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p le_rfl]

@[simp] lemma natDegree_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]).natDegree = n := by
  apply le_antisymm (bounded_natDegree _)
  exact Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_ne_zero (by
    rw [monicPoly_coeff_top]
    exact one_ne_zero)

lemma cut_X_pow_of_le (n k : ℕ) (hnk : n ≤ k) : cut n (X^k) = 0 := by
  apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective
  funext i
  change ((cut n (X^k) : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i = 0
  rw [cut_coeff]
  simp [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, show (i : ℕ) ≠ k from by omega]

/-- Assemble a leading coefficient and all lower coefficients, without division. -/
def joinLeadingLM (n : ℕ) : (ℝ × Coeff n) →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) where
  toFun x := x.1 • topMonomial n + liftCLM n x.2
  map_add' x y := by simp [add_smul]; abel
  map_smul' c x := by simp [smul_add, smul_smul]

@[simp] lemma coe_joinLeadingLM {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    (joinLeadingLM n x : ℝ[X]) = x.1 • (X^n : ℝ[X]) + (x.2 : ℝ[X]) := by
  simp [joinLeadingLM, topMonomial]

/-- Split a bounded polynomial into its leading coefficient and its truncation. -/
def splitLeadingLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) →ₗ[ℝ] (ℝ × Coeff n) :=
  ((Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ n).comp (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype).prod
    ((cut n).comp (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype)

@[simp] lemma splitLeadingLM_apply {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    splitLeadingLM n p = ((p : ℝ[X]).coeff n, cut n (p : ℝ[X])) := rfl

lemma split_joinLeading {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    splitLeadingLM n (joinLeadingLM n x) = x := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp [coe_joinLeadingLM, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound x.2 le_rfl]
  · simp [coe_joinLeadingLM, cut_X_pow_of_le n n le_rfl]

lemma join_splitLeading {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    joinLeadingLM n (splitLeadingLM n p) = p := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_joinLeadingLM]
  ext k
  simp only [splitLeadingLM_apply, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_smul,
    smul_eq_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
  rcases lt_trichotomy k n with h | h | h
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_lt h), mul_zero, zero_add]
    exact cut_coeff n (p : ℝ[X]) ⟨k,h⟩
  · subst k
    rw [if_pos rfl, mul_one, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ le_rfl, add_zero]
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_gt h), mul_zero,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ h.le, zero_add,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)]

/-- The exact linear isomorphism between high-first and ordinary polynomial coefficients. -/
def leadingEquiv (n : ℕ) : (ℝ × Coeff n) ≃ₗ[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  { joinLeadingLM n with
    invFun := splitLeadingLM n
    left_inv := split_joinLeading
    right_inv := join_splitLeading }

@[simp] lemma leadingEquiv_apply {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    leadingEquiv n x = joinLeadingLM n x := rfl

@[simp] lemma leadingEquiv_symm_apply {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    (leadingEquiv n).symm p = splitLeadingLM n p := rfl

lemma monicPoly_eq_leadingEquiv {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    monicPoly p = leadingEquiv n (1,p) := by
  simp [monicPoly, leadingEquiv, joinLeadingLM]

/-- Leading degree first, then increasing lower degrees. -/
def leadingBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (Unit ⊕ Fin n) ℝ (Coeff (n+1)) :=
  ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)).map (leadingEquiv n)

/-- Truncation is exact whenever the original polynomial already satisfies the bound. -/
lemma coe_cut_of_degree_lt {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.degree < n) :
    (cut n p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  let q : Coeff n := ⟨p, Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr hp⟩
  exact congrArg (fun z : Coeff n => (z : ℝ[X])) (cut_coe q)

/-- Actual monic polynomials are recovered from their non-leading coefficients. -/
lemma monic_reconstruct {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.Monic) (hd : p.natDegree = n) :
    (monicPoly (cut n p) : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  ext k
  rw [coe_monicPoly, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
  rcases lt_trichotomy k n with hk | hk | hk
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_lt hk), zero_add]
    exact cut_coeff n p ⟨k,hk⟩
  · subst k
    rw [if_pos rfl, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ le_rfl, add_zero]
    rw [← hd, Polynomial.coeff_natDegree, hp]
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_gt hk), zero_add,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ hk.le,
      Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)]

    A.adjugate 0 0 = (A.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).det := by
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix]
  simp

    (A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s - A)⁻¹ 0 0 =
      (A.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).charpoly.eval s / A.charpoly.eval s := by
  rw [Matrix.inv_def]
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
  rw [root_adjugate_eq_principal_det, scalar_sub_principal,
    ← Matrix.eval_charpoly, ← Matrix.eval_charpoly]

    (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s - A) * (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s - A)⁻¹ = 1 := by
  have hd : IsUnit (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s - A).det := by
    rw [← Matrix.eval_charpoly, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]

open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] [LinearOrder C] {V : C → Type*}
  [∀ c, Fintype (V c)] [∀ c, DecidableEq (V c)]

def arrowRow (r : ∀ c, V c) (a : C → ℝ) : Matrix Unit (Σ c, V c) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun _ z => if z.2 = r z.1 then a z.1 else 0

def arrowColumn (r : ∀ c, V c) (f : C → ℝ) : Matrix (Σ c, V c) Unit ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun z _ => if z.2 = r z.1 then f z.1 else 0

/-- The root diagonal is d and every branch block is retained unaltered. -/
def arrowMatrix (d : ℝ) (B : ∀ c, Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ)
    (r : ∀ c, V c) (a f : C → ℝ) : Matrix (Unit ⊕ (Σ c, V c)) (Unit ⊕ (Σ c, V c)) ℝ :=
  Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.of fun _ _ => d) (arrowRow r a) (arrowColumn r f)
    (Matrix.blockDiagonal' B)

lemma arrowRow_mul_block (r : ∀ c, V c) (a : C → ℝ)
    (G : ∀ c, Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ) (c : C) (i : V c) :

  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_sigma, Finset.sum_eq_single c]
  · simp only [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_eq]
    simp [arrowRow, ite_mul]
  · intro d _ hdc
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_ne G j i hdc, mul_zero]
  · simp

    (G : ∀ c, Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ) :
    (arrowRow r a * Matrix.blockDiagonal' G * arrowColumn r f) () () =
      ∑ c, a c * G c (r c) (r c) * f c := by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c _
  simp only [arrowRow_mul_block]
  simp [arrowColumn, mul_ite]
